resources.string: One word or phrase per line; case-insensitive. Only comments and replies are affected.
One exact display name per line; case-insensitive. Authors sharing the same name will all be hidden.
Zero disables this filter. Comments with unknown like counts remain visible. Requires content blocking to be enabled for Comments.
One RE2 expression per line, without slash delimiters. Case-insensitive; applies to enabled blocking targets. Existing plain-text keywords are unchanged.
Invalid or unsupported regex. Use at most 32 expressions, 512 characters each, and 16,384 characters total. Lookaround and backreferences are unsupported.
